summary: The candidate fixes the recorded base collision for file keys, preserves explicit fp8_e4m3 versus fp8_e5m2 in the production storage config, and threads dtype into UMBP. Its focused 60-test suite passes. It does not fulfill the original issue's all-backend contract: the built-in AIBrix HiCache backend ignores HiCacheStorageConfig.kv_cache_dtype and neither namespaces BlockHashes nor refuses operation. An independent stubbed-client harness demonstrated identical AIBrix hash inputs for fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2.

tests.what_was_measured: Original failure: bf16 and fp8_e4m3 HiCacheFile keys were identical; production E4M3/E5M2 configs both lacked a dtype; UMBP prefix construction did not mention dtype.
Candidate passes independent file-key, explicit FP8 logical-format, and UMBP source-path checks.
Candidate regression suite: 60 passed, including local hf3fs round-trip/isolation mocks and UMBP prefix/config propagation.
Independent AIBrix boundary: fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 produced the identical BlockHashes input ((same_page,), 64), proving the backend ignores the new dtype namespace and does not fail closed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned GPU was detected as one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015. Contract tests exercised CPU key derivation and stubbed unavailable external clients; no model or GPU kernel execution was needed or claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: AibrixKVCacheStorage accepts HiCacheStorageConfig.kv_cache_dtype but passes the original unscoped page keys directly to BlockHashes. With a shared native FP8 dtype, fp8_e4m3 and fp8_e5m2 therefore produce identical key inputs, and the backend does not refuse loudly.

The original issue's external FlexKV and LMCache client key derivation was not changed by this candidate and could not be verified because those packages/services are absent. This is an unverified portion of the original all-backend contract, not evidence of resolution.

Other registered persistent HiCache backends not modified by the candidate, including NPU memcache and SiMM, derive component keys without the new dtype field; their services and required architectures were unavailable for end-to-end confirmation.
remaining_limitations: AIBrix, FlexKV, LMCache, EIC, UMBP, NPU memcache, SiMM, and external hf3fs services were unavailable; only source-path tests, local hf3fs mocks, and a stubbed AIBrix manager were possible.
No model weights, serving process, multi-node environment, or cross-run external cache service was used.
The host is gfx950 (AMD Instinct MI355X). NPU-only and service-specific architectures were not available.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
